subject: general
question: Which of the following letters is 5th to the right of the 12th letter from the left of the English alphabet when written starting from the left to right?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee698a15684e038bb3a098369fea108fe9a82cb18e65ef96883d6a6a19b258d0.png] 

The logic followed here is:

12th letter from the left of the English alphabet = L

5th letter to the right of L + 5 = Q

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
